Full stack & Machine Learning 
Assignment 
Instructions: Send us a GitHub repo with your code and a README that explains how to run it. 
Use whatever language and framework you like. Using AI assistants is fine, just be ready to talk 
through any part of what you submit. 
​
Question 1: PDF Q&A with Highlighted Sources 
Build a web app where someone uploads a PDF, asks a question about it, and gets an answer 
with the PDF displayed alongside. The parts of the document the answer came from should be 
highlighted directly on the page, and clicking a citation in the answer should scroll to that 
highlight. 
Requirements: 
●​ Work on documents of 50 pages or more 
●​ Show the PDF in the browser and draw highlights over the actual text. A page-number 
reference or a downloaded annotated file isn't what we're after 
●​ Highlight every supporting passage, including when they sit on different pages 
●​ Stream the answer as it's generated 
●​ Say so when the document doesn't contain the answer, rather than guessing and 
highlighting something at random 
●​ Survive a corrupted, oversized, or scanned-with-no-text PDF without breaking 
Deliverables: 
●​ The app, running from a single documented command, plus a two-minute screen 
recording 
●​ Results from trying it on ten questions across a couple of documents. Tell us how often 
the right passage was retrieved, and separately, how often the highlight landed on the 
right text 
●​ A few notes on how you mapped text back to positions on the page, and what kinds of 
layouts give it trouble​
​
​

Question 2: Atari Breakout Training Studio 
Build Atari Breakout in the browser, then build a small studio around it for training an agent to 
play. We want to kick off a run, watch the game while the agent learns, and see the reward 
curve fill in as it goes. 
Requirements: 
●​ Paddle, ball, bricks, lives, score, and an interface your training code can drive: one call 
to take an action and get back state and reward, another to reset with a seed so runs 
repeat 
●​ Train an agent against that same environment. DQN, PPO, cross-entropy, whatever you 
prefer, but write the training loop yourself rather than calling into stable-baselines 
●​ Show gameplay live while training runs, with reward and episode length charting 
alongside 
●​ Start and pause a run, set the main hyperparameters, save checkpoints and load them 
back 
●​ Let someone load a saved checkpoint and play against it, or pit it against an earlier 
checkpoint 
Deliverables: 
●​ The studio running from a single command, the trained weights, and the script that 
produced them 
●​ A minute or so of video: a training run in progress, then a finished agent playing 
●​ The training curve, and a short write-up of what the agent picked up, what it never 
figured out, and where it falls apart 
 
Submission Guidelines: 
1.​ GitHub Repository containing:​
 
○​ All source code with clear documentation 
○​ Requirements.txt, package.json or environment.yml 
○​ README with setup and running instructions 
○​ Sample input/output files​
 
2.​ Report (PDF, can be short with bullet points):​
 
○​ Implementation approach for each question

○​ Results and performance analysis 
○​ Challenges faced and solutions 
○​ Future improvements. 
3.​ Demo videos​
 
4.​ Email the deliverables to aditya.patil@sapienrobotics.ai
